# Song of Songs Chapter 8 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 414v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/SNG_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**8:6** Set-me [simeni] as-a-seal [ka-chotam] upon your-heart [al-libbkha], as-a-seal upon your-arm [zero'ekha]; for strong [azzah] as-death [ka-mavet] [is] love [ahavah], fierce [qashah] as-Sheol [ki-she'ol] [is] jealousy [qin'ah]; its-flames [reshafeyha] [are] flames of-fire [rishpei esh], the-flame [shalhevetya] of-YAH.

**8:7** Many [rabbim] waters [mayim] cannot quench [lo yukhlu le-khabbbot] love [ha-ahavah], and-rivers [u-neharot] cannot wash-it-away [lo yishtefuha]; if a-man [ish] would-give [yitten] all the-wealth [hon] of-his-house [beito] for-love, they-would-utterly-despise [boz yavuzu] him.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Song of Songs 8 — the most explicitly erotic text in the biblical canon. The council reads it as love poetry first, without imposing allegorical frameworks (YHWH-Israel, Christ-Church) that, while historically important, are not intrinsic to the Hebrew text.

---
## Disagreement Log

Minor register variations resolved through standard consensus process.

---
*— SOPHIA, in council with EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA*
